notes.title: SAE Alpha 0.1.2: Release Notes
notes.content:
[url=https://www.sae-game.com/post/sae-alpha-0-1-2-release-notes]Read Relese Noten on our Website[/url]

[h3]After receiving a lot of useful information and bug reports in the first week after the release of the Early Access version, the following things have been changed:[/h3]

[list]
[*]XP for breaking crystals reduced to 100 to 220
[*]Increased brightness in the jungle
[*]World border added so that you can no longer fall off the map
[*]Statistic "Coal Ores Mined" now works
[*]Increased Durability on Items:
Iron Axe: 60 → 100
Iron Dagger: 50 → 100
Iron Pickaxe: 60 → 100
Iron Shovel: 15 → 40
Stone Axe: 30 → 60
Stone Dagger: 30 → 60
Wooden Spear: 15 → 30
Simple Lighter: 5 → 20
Flashlight: 10 → 50
Hammer: 10 → 40
[*]Jumping into the water now works correctly and no longer deals fall damage
[/list]

notes.title: The time has finally come - the release of SAE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The time has finally come - the release of SAE![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/b29b53f38ade60624fbdddd74d639f43ed3777ca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

Hello folks!

No, you have not misread! SAE is actually being released in [b]Early Access[/b] after a few delays!

[b]Mark the date in your calendars: January 14th, 2025![/b]

Yes, that's right, [b]only one month[/b] to go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/8351f7001d1ffa7defd4059e9b830a97eceda8e3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]How much is still missing?[/b][/h2]

As you can easily see from the release date, [b]not much is missing[/b] for the Early Access release. Basically, everything that needs to be finished is finished; there are just a [b]few finishing touches to be made and tested![/b]

[h3][b]Wishlist now![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]There will be more updates in the coming weeks![/b][/h2]

Of course, we don't want to withhold anything from you. That's why there will be more updates in the near future.[b][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]Free postcard![/b][/h2]

To [b]celebrate[/b] this very important stage, we have decided to offer the [b]2024 Edition postcards for free![/b] This is because we no longer need them next year and there are still some left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/3c8a571fc949198eec6a5b37fb37645a5e50ee2d.png[/img]

All postcards are [b]handwritten[/b] and can also be [b]SAE-stamped[/b] on request during the ordering process. Free of charge, of course!

[b][url=https://www.sae-game.com/product-page/personalized-sae-postcard-2024-series]Click here to get to our shop![/url][/b]

[b]So pick one up now for free; only while stocks last![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]Get it before it's too late: Limited Edition Stingray Poster![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/16fd3499721a64a33018a2cccb61bdd0fabad20f.png[/img]

[b]We have spared no effort to create a new poster, limited to 20 copies.[/b] Get your hands on one of the few posters showing the development of the Stingray at SAE. The poster is in [b]A3 format (29.7 x 42.0 cm)[/b]. Printed on [b]high-quality, 250g/m2, glossy photo paper[/b] with vivid colors and crisp details. Our posters are sure to make a statement wherever they're displayed.

[url=https://www.sae-game.com/product-page/sae-stingray-development-poster][b]Click here to get one![/b][/url]

You too can decorate your room with a stingray!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[b]Thank You for reading![/b]

notes.title: How do we bring SAE to life for you? Here is how: The Stingray
notes.content:
[h1]How do we bring SAE to life for you? Here is how we bring the Stingray in the Game![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to a different sort of update![/b]

In this update we will introduce you to our latest creation, the Stingray, and give you a glimpse into the development of such animals. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]Manta or Stingray?[/b][/h2]

About three weeks ago, we were wondering how we could animate the oceans more in our game SAE. That's when I came across one of our favorite animals: The stingray and the manta ray.

After some careful consideration, we decided to use the stingray because it has a wider range and more exciting behaviors than the manta ray.

[b]So let's get to it - enjoy the following insights![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]Get it before it's too late: Limited Edition Stingray Poster![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/16fd3499721a64a33018a2cccb61bdd0fabad20f.png[/img]

[b]We have spared no effort to create a new poster, limited to 20 copies.[/b] Get your hands on one of the few posters showing the [b]development of the Stingray at SAE[/b]. The poster is in [b]A3 format (29.7 x 42.0 cm)[/b]. Printed on [b]high-quality, 250g/m2, glossy photo paper with vivid colors[/b] and crisp details. Our posters are sure to make a statement wherever they're displayed.

[list]
[*]Get it here: [url=https://www.sae-game.com/product-page/sae-stingray-development-poster]https://www.sae-game.com/product-page/sae-stingray-development-poster[/url]
[/list]

You too can decorate your room with a stingray!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]Step 1: What does a stingray look like in real life?[/b][/h2]

When the rough model is finished, smooth the surface - in Blender with Modifiers - and sculpt the finer details, such as the eye sockets.



First, we look for as many sources as possible to create an accurate model of the stingray. This involves looking at and reading a lot of pictures, videos and articles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/fc23aba16a0918d0bd96b4f92d49c9efb1164fd9.jpg[/img]
Source: [url=https://animalia.bio/common-stingray]https://animalia.bio/common-stingray[/url]

[h2][b]Step 2: The rough shape[/b][/h2]

The next step is to create a (very) rough model in 3D software. The following scheme is used when creating 3D models: From rough to fine. You start as rough as possible and add more and more detail over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/4a102049d26b694bd7181463be5832b587bd824b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/a2f052f675c7f692727cbbd1fd85038dfd5ef49b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/7da21b9ae56daf69ef517d22536d20a839afada9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/9c16f2186fc6e495ea7d6d8d5ecc001a3613cf34.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/55173c6db371a9d1ef5fc0b733dc867cee4ab220.png[/img]

[h2][b]Step 3: Smooth and sculpt the surface[/b][/h2]

When the rough model is finished, smooth the surface - in Blender with Modifiers - and sculpt the finer details, such as the eye sockets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/5b7ac0e0c341119518c094c255aadfa847803a73.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/a2f052f675c7f692727cbbd1fd85038dfd5ef49b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/fd115b8f347bec0324a506956c6dc6936dcdcec6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/9c16f2186fc6e495ea7d6d8d5ecc001a3613cf34.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/89f999f382cabddbf6ee7162613409a0f1727ae2.png[/img]

[h2][b]Step 4: Adding the skeleton[/b][/h2]

In order to add animations, a skeleton must be added to the model. These bones must then be assigned to the appropriate body parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f02e4a7b11db8b346f43222ebcb86362d174e09a.png[/img]

[h2][b]Step 5: The textures[/b][/h2]

What else do you need? Right, the textures! Again, first rough, then more and more detailed. Then you need a normal map and a roughness map, which can create artificial roughness and shine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/575eb4bc70fdd7ff01e9c7ccf8bd8614a2f15060.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/9c16f2186fc6e495ea7d6d8d5ecc001a3613cf34.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/38fd27d4bd2c016d35bb12bff83ff88af45d2b71.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/54bdea098e99a724f3fedec865ec3d8c1d73d767.png[/img]

Now we're done with the model. But that doesn't mean the stingray is happy swimming around in the water!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]Step 6: Creating animations[/b][/h2]

This step is particularly time-consuming (and nerve-wracking!). Each bone has to be animated individually. Everything has to fit together. And in the end, it has to look realistic.

You can find two videos of the animations [url=https://www.sae-game.com/post/stingray]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[h2][b]Step 7: Behavior, movement and reactions[/b][/h2]

We have come so far, but there is still so much missing. The animal's behavior still needs to be implemented in the game. This takes about 50% of the total time and is also the most boring part.


First, you have to research the behavior of stingrays. Are they solitary or social? Are they aggressive or peaceful? At what depths do they live? What special behaviors can be observed? These and other questions need to be answered before you can get the behavior right.

For example: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stingray]https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stingray[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/f5d33f49b3f8eedf055a38dae97cde18d59fe172.png[/img]

[b]Thank You for reading![/b]

notes.title: Explore SAEs new Website: Your Portal to Thrilling Tropical Survival!
notes.content:
[h1]Our new Website[/h1]

Exciting news awaits! The [b]new official SAE website has officially launched[/b], marking the beginning of an exhilarating journey into the heart of tropical survival. Dive into our immersive online portal, meticulously crafted to be your ultimate companion in navigating the challenges of SAE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/8e572650fef8256f80621f1fadf8706dc9147d75.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]

[b]Gain deep, regular insights into our development and make your ideas and wishes come true. Help us shape SAE for you![/b]

But our website is more than just a repository of information – it's [b]a vibrant community[/b] hub where adventurers like yourself can come together to share experiences, exchange ideas, and forge lasting connections. [b]Create your own profile[/b], interact with fellow explorers, and collaborate on exciting new ventures as we chart the uncharted territories of SAE together.

And let's not forget about our [b]online shop[/b], where you can gear up for your adventure with essential equipment and stylish merchandise. Admittedly, our online store is still pretty empty. But that will change soon!

[h2]🔗[url=https://www.sae-game.com/]www.sae-game.com[/url][/h2]

[h2]Help us develop SAE[/h2]

But perhaps the most exciting aspect of our website is the opportunity it presents for you to actively [b]shape the future and the release of SAE.[/b] Share your ideas, provide feedback, and contribute to the development process as we work tirelessly to make SAE an ultimate survival experience.

[b]Join us on this thrilling adventure and become part of the ever-growing SAE community.[/b] Visit our website today, and let's embark on this unforgettable journey together!

[b]Warm regards,
Your SAE Team[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/8b3b5ce3a667a510a4a5b959cbe885993371ab06.png[/img]

notes.title: SAE is now live on Kickstarter.
notes.content:
[h1]SAE on Kickstarter[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/8ce25a6c84ebdcc53b0f2fdf9b6ebc70ef262900.png[/img]

Our game, SAE, is now on Kickstarter. It has already been successfully funded. If you want to be part of this big milestone, why don't you stop by and get your rewards! For example, you can get the game for the "Adventure Package" for free. There are also cool real-world rewards that you won't want to miss out on.

Here is our campaign: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/saegames/sae-stranded-in-paradise?ref=cda8qf

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/6f5209513848b36f4ceff485fb87ccbf6649ecc6.png[/img]

[h1]Why should you support us?[/h1]

In addition to the generous rewards, you personally help us with development. The development of games is unfortunately time-consuming and very cost-intensive. By supporting us, you help us cover the costs and get something in return! In addition, everyone who supports us will be immortalised in the credits of the game (unless you don't want this).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/443589106b610143ab328a7bf986ce1c972bcfb6.png[/img]

[h2]Thank you very much,[/h2]
[h2]Your SAE Team![/h2]
